conditional_scenario.summary_note: (QB injury flag) Jacoby Brissett-start / opponent unchanged-production scenario only. Week12 role not confirmed; not full injury coverage.
conditional_scenario.assumptions: If Jacoby Brissett starts for BAL and Houston Texans stays at baseline-embedded QB production. Latest inspected source establishes prior Week11 role, NOT Week12 game clearance. Transfer of this-season production across teams/scheme remains an assumption. Opponent unchanged production is not verified health or measured zero injury effect. QB passing only; do not stack with skill-only or other injury scenarios.
conditional_scenario.uncertainty: Coefficient-only bootstrap interval. Partial uncertainty: excludes uncertainty in starter quality (posterior_sd), embedded-proxy error, role/starter uncertainty and selection/confounding. Not a full predictive interval. Association, not causal injury effect. QB rushing and non-QB injuries excluded.
